newsitem.title: USA: Physician sees Q4 revs about $21 mln.
newsitem.headline: Physician sees Q4 revs about $21 mln.

text.p: Physician Support Systems Inc said on Thursday that based upon a preliminary review of results for the fourth quarter of 1996, it expects to report total revenue of $21 million for the quarter ended December 31, 1996 and $74 million for the year ended December 31, 1996.
The company said the amounts compare to $13,711,000 and $58,846,000 for the respective periods in the prior year.
Net income before merger costs and restructuring charges for the quarter ended December 31, 1996 is expected to be breakeven.

The company indicated that revenues in the fourth quarter were reduced compared to the third quarter due to greater than expected seasonality and clients which started later than expected in the fourth quarter. Physician Support said that those factors are expected to be mitigated in 1997.
